# ataila_vms (Data Source)

The projects' virtual machines, in id order: name, environment, role, status and size. No address, host or machine id. Filters combine with AND.

Needs `infrastructure-read-global`; a tenant-scoped token reads its own tenant's projects' VMs. Platform release 1.0.400 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The PROD database VMs of a project.
data "ataila_vms" "shop_prod_db" {
  project_id  = ataila_project.shop.id
  environment = "prod"
  role        = "db"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment` (String) Only this environment's: `dev`, `uat` or `prod`.
- `project_id` (String) Only this project's.
- `role` (String) Only VMs of this role, e.g. `db`.
- `status` (String) Only VMs in this status: `planned`, `provisioning`, `running`, `stopped`, `failed` or `retired`.

### Read-Only

- `vms` (Attributes List) The matching VMs, in id order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) Virtual CPUs.
- `created_at` (String) When it was recorded (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `disk_class` (String) `N` (local, replicated by the software on it) or `C` (network SSD); null for a VM with no disk.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk in GB.
- `environment` (String) `dev`, `uat` or `prod`.
- `id` (String) The VM's id.
- `name` (String) Its host name.
- `pending_hardware` (Boolean) True while the VM waits for its disk hardware.
- `project_id` (String) The project it belongs to.
- `ram_gb` (Number) Memory in GB.
- `role` (String) What it runs.
- `status` (String) `planned`, `provisioning`, `running`, `stopped`, `failed` or `retired`.
